detail.longDescription: The response to LibreOffice's awful "let's all get along" takes on AI is great to see, but I swear, if some fuckers decide to be doxxing or death-threat-sending assholes and we get the whole KDE situation again, I'm gonna crash out. I don't deny that KDE was harassed but it was immediately used as an excuse to label anti-AI activists as insane because a couple people did stupid shit. If a handful of people decide to be stupid again, I'm gonna lose what's left of my orange cat mind, which wasn't much to begin with. That's the post. Goodnight. #Anti-ai #libreoffice #kde #ai #llm #no-ai #fuck-ai #open-source #foss
